text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to finalize what goes on the status page and who gets the full RCA. Incident INC-2026-03-22
aj: Agree. Recommend standardizing: short public summary + timeline; full redacted RCA shared with affected customers or on request under contract. Don’t publish internal stack traces or PII.
olivia: Draft public wording suggestion: "We experienced intermittent inference latency affecting a subset of requests. Service returned to normal at T+3h. We are investigating and will publish an RCA." Thoughts?
sam: Support note — customers want timeline + list of affected models. We can share a concise customer-facing timeline and confirm no data exposure.
aj: Also flag: this is the third cache-eviction spike this quarter. Need telemetry and a recurring review. Action: create KV-cache telemetry ticket. Owner: aj. ETA: 2w.
maria: Putting action items here for tracking:
- Update status page wording (owner: olivia) — ETA 24h
- Draft customer incident summary + affected models (owner: sam) — ETA 48h
- Full RCA (redacted) draft (owner: aj) — ETA 72h
- Telemetry + follow-up postmortem for recurring pattern (owner: aj) — ETA 2w
olivia: For the public copy, avoid jargon. Proposed alternative: "We identified a short-lived caching issue in our inference layer that caused increased latency for some requests. We mitigated the issue and are taking steps to prevent recurrence."
sam: Operationally, if we share a full RCA with a customer, run an NDA/contract check. For enterprise customers, send redacted RCA via support with a secure link.
maria: Policy question — do we default to publishing a short-form public summary for all Sev2+ incidents within 72 hours? If yes, we should add this to the comms playbook.
olivia: I support that. Proposed policy: short-form public summary within 72h for Sev2+, full redacted RCA provided on request or to affected customers, internal full RCA available to org within 7 days.
aj: Suggestion: for recurring incidents include a "mitigation status" banner on the status page until a long-term fix is deployed.
incident-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-22 (access: internal only)
maria: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem action tracker and ping owners. @olivia @aj @sam please confirm ownership in-thread.
olivia: Confirmed — I'll push status page copy and the public summary draft.
aj: Confirmed — RCA draft and telemetry ticket created (links to follow).
sam: Confirmed — drafting customer summary and outreach plan; will coordinate with AEs.
maria: I'll close the loop in 72h or earlier. Thanks :thumbsup:
